Q: Cannot find module 'axios' A:

When you deploy the application, you will upload all the necessary packages to the server, including (possibly) the JavaScript Bundle created by Webpack .

It is possible that the bundle.js was formed after the axios package import was added, but before the axios package itself was installed. After installing axios and re-forming the bundle.js, the error sometimes doesn't go away. After the file bundle.js is formed with errors, Webpack cannot always resolve all dependencies correctly. I've come across this.

You can try to remove all references to axios from the code, generate bundle.js (you can even delete the bundle.js for reliability), then install axios, and after that add the necessary links to axios in code and rebuild again bundle.js to create a new bundle.the js contained the axios package.
